action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-timeline-slot]'); const clips = document.querySelectorAll('[data-clip-source]'); if (slots.length >= 2 && clips.length >= 2) { const evt = new DragEvent('dragstart', {bubbles: true}); clips[0].dispatchEvent(evt); slots[0].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true})); clips[1].dispatchEvent(evt); slots[1].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: At least 2 timeline slots have assigned clips
Active slot count is between 2 and 3
Total energy balance is greater than 0

action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-timeline-slot]'); const clips = document.querySelectorAll('[data-clip-source]'); const brainClip = Array.from(clips).find(c => c.textContent.includes('Brain') || c.style.backgroundColor.includes('blue')); const nemetonaClip = Array.from(clips).find(c => c.textContent.includes('Nemet') || c.style.backgroundColor.includes('gold')); if (brainClip && nemetonaClip && slots[2]) { brainClip.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragstart', {bubbles: true})); slots[2].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Timeline contains clips from both source models
BrainStem clip count is at least 1
Nemetona clip count is at least 1

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); let remaining = 3.0; for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(sliders.length, 3); i++) { const val = i < 2 ? 1.0 : remaining; sliders[i].value = val; sliders[i].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); remaining -= val; }

postconditions: Total energy balance equals exactly 3.0
Energy meter is glowing
Max blend weight is between 0 and 1

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); if (sliders[0]) { sliders[0].value = 0.5; sliders[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } setTimeout(() => { if (sliders[1]) { sliders[1].value = 1.5; sliders[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, 400);

postconditions: Undo stack depth is greater than 0
User actions have been recorded
Redo stack may be empty or populated

action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-timeline-slot]'); const clips = document.querySelectorAll('[data-clip-source]'); let clipIdx = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (slots[i] && !slots[i].hasAttribute('data-occupied')) { if (clips[clipIdx]) { clips[clipIdx].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragstart', {bubbles: true})); slots[i].dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true})); clipIdx++; } } }

postconditions: All 6 timeline slots are occupied
Active slot count equals 6
Both model types represented in timeline

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); const weights = [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5]; for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(sliders.length, 6); i++) { sliders[i].value = weights[i]; sliders[i].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Energy balance restored to exactly 3.0
Energy meter glowing again
All slots remain occupied
System maintains energy balance at 3.0 for 60 seconds
No state corruption or drift
All metrics remain stable
